gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squ: Lowercase that nearly touches cap height gives Expose its tight, striking cadence, with barely a pause between letters. But Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars with its own tall x-height and wide gaps, which keep tiny sizes crisp.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Noto Traditional Nushu moves like a broad-nibbed pen that never curls shut. Expose, compressed and refined with almost no gap between x-height and caps, belongs big and brief, while those full-bowled Nushu letters fill the line beneath.
gen-fs-expose-gf-pathway-extreme: Expose is compression and polish, with almost no gap between x-height and caps. Pathway Extreme takes the quieter job, keeping rounded letters clearly open and using stubby ascenders and descenders to stay compact in running text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-prompt: Lowercase that nearly meets cap height gives Expose its tight cadence. Prompt then keeps long reading easy, its oversized small letters and open apertures letting each word be read at a glance.
gen-fs-expose-gf-puritan: Almost no gap between x-height and caps gives Expose a compressed, striking cadence made for headlines and refined emphasis. Puritan takes the gentler job, rounded and open, with oversized counters.
gen-fs-expose-gf-readex-pro: Tightly packed and strikingly refined, Expose barely pauses. Readex Pro counters with broad gaps at its terminals and a single-width stroke in every glyph, steady from word to word.
gen-fs-expose-gf-ruda: Ruda draws a wire-like monoline skeleton with a sizable x-height and wide-mouthed rounds. And Expose, compressed and striking with almost no gap between x-height and caps, gives that gentleness a sharp counterpoint.
gen-fs-expose-gf-stack-sans-notch: Expose excels at tight, striking statements, its lowercase pressed nearly to cap height. Stack Sans Notch does the open-handed work, with curves you can see right into and rod-stock lines of identical thickness.
gen-fs-expose-gf-tiktok-sans: Expose compresses its letters into a refined, striking line with almost no gap between x-height and caps. TikTok Sans does the everyday work instead, with a spacious c and an x-height rising close to cap height.
